title: Sourcing advisor
subtitle: The advisor no longer scores orders one by one. An order opens its stored run in the simulator, or can be replayed there.

access.deniedTitle: No access to the sourcing advisor
access.deniedHint: Your account does not hold the sourcing advisor grant. Ask an administrator if you need it.
access.unreachableHint: Your access could not be checked, so this screen stays closed. Try again in a moment.

loading: Looking for the order's stored run…
failedTitle: The order's stored run could not be read
failed: Something went wrong reading this order. Try again in a moment.
noOrder: No order number was given. Open an order from Delivery details.

stored.line: Order <order>{{order}}</order> has a stored run, made <at>{{ranAt}}</at>.
stored.needsRunGrant: Opening it in the simulator needs the simulator's run grant.

none.line: Order <order>{{order}}</order> has no stored run: it was never run, or its record is past its 90 days.
none.needsRunGrant: A replay in the simulator needs the simulator's run grant.

unknown: No order or delivery numbered <order>{{asked}}</order> is known.
